Package org.apache.cayenne.project.upgrade

Interface UpgradeHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
UpgradeHandler_V10, UpgradeHandler_V11, UpgradeHandler_V12, UpgradeHandler_V13, UpgradeHandler_V14
public sealed interface UpgradeHandler permits UpgradeHandler_V10, UpgradeHandler_V11, UpgradeHandler_V12, UpgradeHandler_V13, UpgradeHandler_V14
A step of the project upgrade that brings the XML and the model from the previous project version to the version it reports in getVersion(). The set of handlers is closed: every handler is a permitted implementation of this interface.
Since:
4.1
